recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的顆粒球細胞核中央有一個洞，形成甜甜圈狀的環形核（ring/doughnut nucleus），細胞質淡藍、顆粒稀少；周圍數顆骨髓細胞與後骨髓細胞也顆粒偏少。環形核與顆粒減少都是顆粒球生成異常（dysgranulopoiesis）的表現。
features: Granulocytic precursor with a ring-shaped (doughnut) nucleus containing a central clear hole (arrow)
Pale blue, hypogranular cytoplasm in the ring-nucleus cell and several neighboring myelocytes/metamyelocytes
Other myeloid precursors with kidney-shaped or indented nuclei and clumped chromatin
A promyelocyte-like cell with prominent azurophilic granules and a large, folded monocytoid cell present
Erythroid precursor with deep blue cytoplasm; background RBCs with drying artifact
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows maturing granulocytic precursors with dysplastic features. A metamyelocyte/band-stage cell contains a ring-shaped nucleus with a central cytoplasmic hole (arrow), and it and several neighboring myelocytes have pale, hypogranular cytoplasm. A granular promyelocyte, an erythroid precursor and a larger cell with folded nucleus are also present. Findings are consistent with dysgranulopoiesis; quantification (at least 10% dysplastic cells) and exclusion of reactive causes such as drugs, alcohol or copper deficiency are required before attributing this to a myelodysplastic neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Pelger-type cells show hyposegmented bilobed or round nuclei with coarse chromatin, not a nucleus with a central hole.
Occasional ring forms occur in reactive states; the distinction relies on the frequency of dysplasia, multilineage involvement and clinical context.
Megaloblastic change produces giant metamyelocytes with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony, often with megaloblastic erythroids and low B12/folate.
